thresholds_note: Signed 22 Nov 2026 by Ahmed Zayed: CRITERIA_FOR_SIGNOFF rows 1-4 as proposed (EVIDENCE T1-T4). Single-centre values; retrospective use only.
season_window_rule: Season window = first and last day-of-year, within the named-month outer bound (olive Apr-Jun, grass Mar-Jul, birch Mar-Apr), where the training-years (2021-2023) mean of observed daily counts, after a 7-day centred rolling mean (min_periods=1) computed per training year and then averaged day-of-year across those training years, is >= 1 grain/m3. Training years only (2021-2023) are used to derive the window; 2024-2025 are held out and never influence it.

check1_observed_counts_exist.note: Madrid (D1), Basel and Zurich (D2) observed counts downloaded and cached; see data/DATA_CARD.md.

check2_beats_api.note: Per DATA_PLAN 2.5 rule 2: if R1 does not beat P2 on pooled recall at equal-or-fewer false-alert days, or R2 does not beat both P2 and C0 on mean lead days with a season-block bootstrap interval (resampling city-species-year onset rows) that excludes zero, then no 'beats the API' claim is made. The headline becomes the measured P2 skill.

check3_madrid_p2_recall.note: If true, DATA_PLAN 2.5 rule 3 requires the app's alert level be lowered only with Ahmed's re-sign-off; otherwise the headline is reported as a 'limits' number.

check4_valencia_never_scored.note: Valencia is excluded from CITY_SPECIES and never appears in results.

nasa_evaluation.status: exploratory: N1 and N2 were added on 22 Nov 2026 after the pre-registered backtest; not pre-registered

rule_definitions.no_nasa_control: API(D) x k on every day, no NASA input, no washout; k chosen on 2021-2023 with the same CSI-under-precision-floor rule as N2. N2 must beat this to claim a NASA contribution.
rule_definitions.N1: cum GDD from Jan 1 (base olive 7C, birch/grass 5C) reaches the TRAINING-year median of cum GDD at (observed_onset - 14d); first date in [Jan 15, season_end].
rule_definitions.N2: API(D) x k when prior-day (D-1) NASA POWER solar (>= train median), Tmax (>= train median), and dry (< 2.0 mm precip); optional washout (prior-day precip >= 5 mm -> no alert); no same-day NASA value is used; (k, washout) chosen on 2021-2023 by CSI subject to precision >= 0.8 x P2 train precision.

latency_sensitivity_lag3.note: N2 recalibrated and re-scored with D-3 NASA POWER predictors (MERRA-2 publication latency ~2-3 days).
